traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Cucurbitales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral; Coriariaceae opposite.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Cucurbitales page (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral at order level; Begonia often two-ranked (DELTA Begoniaceae: spiral or distichous) and states its own value.

traits.division_pattern.note: APweb, Cucurbitales page (read 2026-10-16): Cucurbitaceae palmately veined/lobed; DELTA Begoniaceae: blades lobed, sometimes palmately compound; Datisca pinnate.

traits.life_span.note: DELTA, Begoniaceae (read 2026-10-16): mostly perennial; APweb Cucurbitales page: Cucurbitaceae climbers, some annual. Woody families perennial.

traits.inflorescence.note: DELTA, Begoniaceae (read 2026-10-16): cymose, usually axillary; APweb: Coriaria racemose, Datisca fascicles on a raceme. Weighted by Begonia (largest family).

traits.flowering_position.note: DELTA, Begoniaceae (read 2026-10-16): inflorescences usually axillary; APweb: Cucurbitaceae tendrils and flowers from the axils. Corynocarpus panicles terminal.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Cucurbitales page (read 2026-10-16) and DELTA Begoniaceae: Begonia flowers somewhat irregular; the other families radial.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Cucurbitales page (read 2026-10-16): hypanthium in many Cucurbitaceae; Begonia has none (DELTA). Weighted by Begonia.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Cucurbitales page (read 2026-10-16): inferior in Cucurbitaceae, Anisophylleaceae, Begoniaceae (DELTA); superior in Coriaria and Corynocarpus.

traits.carpels.note: DELTA, Begoniaceae (read 2026-10-16): 2-3 (to 6) carpels; Cucurbitaceae 3 (family states); Coriaria 5; Datisca/Tetramelaceae 3-8.

traits.sexual_system.note: DELTA, Begoniaceae (read 2026-10-16): monoecious; APweb: Cucurbitaceae monoecious or dioecious, Datisca and Tetramelaceae dioecious, Coriaria bisexual.
